problem: Develop a more efficient language modeling approach than recurrent neural networks.
method: Using stacked convolutions with a novel simplified gating mechanism.
key_result: Achieves state-of-the-art results on WikiText-103 and competitive results on Google Billion Words benchmark.
one_liner: This paper presents a novel language modeling approach using gated convolutional networks, achieving state-of-the-art results on large-scale language tasks.
